note: Chapter ids, in book order, for the Risala. Ids are fixed here so they never depend on position. `expectedAr` must match the heading line found in the base source (letters only, hamza forms folded); the build stops if it does not. `headingEn` is a library-written navigation label, not a translation, and is unreviewed. The introduction has no heading in the source: its Arabic label is the library's, marked `libraryHeading`.
